Regarded as the progenitors of geniekind, janns hold a position of esteem above the genies tied to specific planes. They possess an inborn ability to grant wishes, which the other branches of geniekind lack and greatly envy. Nomadic jann shuyookhs rarely hold court, preferring to gather only when the need arises to perform great deeds. Lesser janns respect and venerate these leaders for their wisdom and total dedication to preserving the honor and reputation of their people. A jann shuyookh reads portents and omens when dealing with duplicitous mortals. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 28 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 26 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 23 [Jann Shuyookh](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2688) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 227 **Perception** +18; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Muan](/Languages.aspx?ID=108), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109), [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110), [Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111), [Talican](/Languages.aspx?ID=112), [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=340) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +17, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +19, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +18, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +16, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +17, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +19, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +18 **Str** +6 **Dex** +4 **Con** +4 **Int** +3 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +4 **Items** _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=38)_, _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [composite longbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=74)_ --- **AC** 27 **Fort** +19 **Ref** +17 **Will** +18 **HP** 155 **Resistances** elemental resistance 10 **Commanding Presence** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) 20 feet. A creature that enters the aura must succeed at a DC 26 Will save or be [frightened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) (frightened 3 on a critical failure), and is then temporarily immune for 1 minute. A [genie](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=50) (with the exception of another jann) takes a –4 circumstance penalty to their save.
**Elemental Resistance** The jann shuyookh's elemental resistance applies to cold, electricity, and fire damage, as well as all damage from elemental sources (including [environmental damage](/Rules.aspx?ID=642) from the elemental planes and damage from anything with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165), or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508) trait). --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 20 feet **Melee** _scimitar_ +20 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)), **Damage** 2d6+12 slashing and All Made One **Melee** fist +19 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188)), **Damage** 1d8+9 bludgeoning and All Made One **Ranged** _composite longbow_ +18 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [volley 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=201)), **Damage** 2d8+9 piercing and all made one **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 28 - **Cantrips (4th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Know Direction](/Spells.aspx?ID=169) - **4th** [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (×2), [Read Omens](/Spells.aspx?ID=247) - **7th** [Plane Shift](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) (at will; to [Astral Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=8), Elemental Planes, or the [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) only) - **Constant (5th)** [Tongues](/Spells.aspx?ID=340) **All Made One** The jann shuyookh calls upon all the elements that make up their being and chooses one. They gain an additional arcane spell they can cast at will and empower their Strikes with the element, dealing an extra 1d6 damage of the listed type. These benefits last until the shuyookh uses this ability again. **Air** [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=172), 1d6 electricity; **earth** [_one with stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=188), 1d6 bludgeoning; **fire** [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=119), 1d6 fire; **metal** [_noxious metals_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1376), 1d6 electricity; **water** [_wall of water_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1028), 1d6 bludgeoning; **wood** [_wall of thorns_](/Spells.aspx?ID=366), 1d6 piercing. **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=8)** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The genie transforms into a Small or Medium [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=57) or [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9). This doesn't affect the genie's statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes **Wanderer's Wish** **Frequency** three times per year; **Effect** The jann instantly grants the benefits of a critical success with the _wish_ ritual to a mortal creature. This has no cost. That creature specifies what they wish for, but the interpretation is up to the jann. A jann typically attempts to grant wishes in a way that encourages growth and exploration. A summoned jann can't use this ability.
Evolving Essence With the return of the metal and wood elemental planes, janns found new elemental magic surging within their beings. This has caused rapid physical changes, and janns anticipate that it could eventually even change their moods and thoughts. Though most janns now feel the full breadth of elemental power, some still find themselves limited to just the elements of air, earth, fire, and water, or have diminished influence over metal and wood compared to the other four elements.
